description: tx.sign: signing, sponsorship, key authorizations and keychain access keys. Cases with node run in order on one fresh dev node.

cases.name: minimal
cases.description: One TIP-20 transfer call, protocol nonce, no fee token.
cases.source: tempo-go transaction_vectors_test.go minimal_transaction; ox TxEnvelopeTempo.test.ts serialize minimal

cases.name: second_nonce
cases.description: Nonce 1 for the same sender as a prior case in this file (runner sends nonce 0 first).

cases.name: with_fee_token
cases.description: Explicit fee token preference (pathUSD).

cases.name: fee_token_alpha_usd
cases.description: Fee token set to a second TIP-20 (AlphaUSD); the sender holds none, so the node rejects it.

cases.name: multiple_calls_batch
cases.description: Three calls executed atomically.
cases.source: tempo-go multiple_calls_batch; ox serialize multiple calls

cases.name: zero_value_empty_data
cases.description: Call to an EOA with zero value and empty data.

cases.name: call_with_value
cases.description: Call with non-zero value; Tempo has no native token, so the node rejects it.

cases.name: contract_creation
cases.description: First call deploys Counter (to = null).

cases.name: access_list
cases.description: Access list with one address and one storage key.

cases.name: user_nonce_key_1
cases.description: 2D nonce: nonce key 1.

cases.name: user_nonce_key_large
cases.description: 2D nonce: 128-bit nonce key.

cases.name: valid_before
cases.description: Expires in 2100.

cases.name: valid_after
cases.description: Valid after 1 second past epoch (already valid).

cases.name: validity_window
cases.description: validAfter < validBefore, both set.

cases.name: expired_valid_before
cases.description: validBefore in the past: signs, but the node rejects it.

cases.name: wrong_chain_id
cases.description: Signed for chain 1; the dev node (1337) rejects it.

cases.name: sponsored
cases.description: Fee payer co-signs and pays; the sender holds no tokens.
cases.source: tempo-go sponsored_transaction; ox serialize with feePayerSignature

cases.name: sponsored_with_fee_token
cases.description: Fee payer picks the fee token; the sender payload leaves it out.

cases.name: key_authorization
cases.description: Root signs a tx that also authorizes a secp256k1 access key with a pathUSD limit.
cases.source: ox serialize keyAuthorization (secp256k1); tempo-go keychain SignAndAttach

cases.name: keychain_access_key
cases.description: The access key authorized above signs for the root account (V2 keychain signature).
cases.source: tempo-go keychain SignWithAccessKey; ox SignatureEnvelope keychain

cases.name: keychain_sponsored
cases.description: Access key signs, fee payer co-signs.

cases.name: keychain_unauthorized_key
cases.description: A key the root never authorized signs for it; the node rejects it.

cases.name: key_authorization_expiry_periodic_limit
cases.description: Access key with an expiry and a daily pathUSD limit.

cases.name: keychain_periodic_key
cases.description: The periodic-limit access key signs for its root.

cases.name: key_authorization_no_spending
cases.description: Access key with limits = [] (no spending allowed).

cases.name: keychain_no_spending_transfer
cases.description: The no-spending key tries a pathUSD transfer: the pool rejects it (SpendingLimitExceeded).

cases.name: tempo_go_minimal_transaction
cases.description: tempo-go golden: chain 1, anvil key 0, no node submission.

cases.name: reject_empty_calls
cases.description: calls = [] is invalid.

cases.name: reject_inverted_validity_window
cases.description: validAfter > validBefore.

cases.name: reject_equal_validity_window
cases.description: validAfter == validBefore.

cases.name: reject_tip_above_fee_cap
cases.description: maxPriorityFeePerGas > maxFeePerGas.
